label: The decision record remains intentionally save-bound: the shared queue captures answers, then save selects the target packet and the central writer persists them. Do not add live record writers; improve pending-answer delivery.

The pending nudge only has Claude Stop and OpenCode system-text delivery, and Claude's async exit message can be lost before the next prompt even though the answer remains queued. Reuse the existing count helper at a user-visible lifecycle point.

Codex's save-time rollout reader is the trust-safe design and passed the 006 live run; Cursor remains unverified and Hermes has no coverage-table row. Add status/probe coverage before any new adapter.

Chat candidates already pair ordered turns with source IDs, while save.md still delegates semantic association and process filtering uses both text and option labels. Use existing IDs for unique pairs and leave ambiguous shared replies pending; do not add another classifier.
Codex and Pi return null and exit 0 on unreadable transcript files, unlike Claude and Devin's visible error and nonzero exit. Reuse the established error-result convention.

The handover says the later runtime and chat work had not started, but the current 006 summary and result rows record all five runtime runs as passing. Treat the handover as stale and refresh it through its owner later.
